# Generic File

## Summary
The untyped file card — what an upload becomes when no typed FileDef claims
its MIME type. Carries the universal file facts (name, size, content type,
URL) and renders with the generic file chrome.

## Example
```ts
import FileDef from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-api';

@field attachment = linksTo(FileDef);
```
Prefer the typed defs (PNG File, MP3 File, …) when the format is known —
they add format-aware rendering; this is the safe fallback.
